About Us We are Sarith Surith and The News, a Sri Lankan acoustic band that brings soulful melodies, heartfelt lyrics, and rich harmonies to life. With a deep passion for music, we blend traditional Sri Lankan influences with modern acoustic sounds, creating an unforgettable experience for our listeners. From intimate unplugged performances to grand stages, we strive to connect with audiences through our unique storytelling and soothing arrangements. Whether it\'s classic hits, original compositions, or refreshing acoustic renditions, our music is crafted to touch hearts and bring people together. Join us on this musical journey, feel the rhythm, and immerse yourself in the sound of Sarith Surith and The News!
